title: Travellers
notes: Migrated list/detail/new pages onto ListPage/DetailPage/EntityForm archetypes; added a real edit page (was a modal) with pre-filled values. Wired PUT /:id/link-contact and /:id/unlink-contact via a Link Contact dialog and detail-page action, plus a Linked Contact section on the overview tab. Added 'Travellers' to the sidebar (Operations group) since it had no direct nav entry. No addressAutocomplete/currencyInput — traveller records have no address or money fields, so those archetype slots are not applicable.
showcaseScript: Open Travellers and search by passport number
Add a traveller with passport and expiry details
Link the traveller to an existing contact
Open the traveller and see their visa applications
